subject: short layered male hair, front view (D = pupil line to chin bottom)
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, adult male (Leo, official render)

silhouette.reference: Big rounded hair mass about 1.35 D above the pupils with several thin strands flying up and out above it (to about 1.52 D); hair half width about 0.80 D above the ears; the whole outline is broken into many fine pointed strand tips.
silhouette.ours: Rounded hair mass about 1.45 D above the pupils with two thin spikes standing up (to 1.63 D) and several thin strands arching up over the top; hair half width 0.90 D above the ears; pointed tips along the bottom and sides.

fringe.reference: A wide sheet of overlapping pointed clumps swept from his right (image left) toward his left; the longest point crosses the brow line between the brows to just above the upper lid (about 0.08 D above the pupils); forehead shows in a triangle above his left eye (image right).
fringe.ours: A wide sheet of overlapping pointed clumps with thin strands on top, swept from his right (image left) toward his left; the longest point crosses the brow line to just above the upper lid of the image-left eye (about 0.06 D above the pupils); forehead shows above both eyes, a larger triangle on the image right.

clumps.reference: Many fine pointed strands grouped into clumps, thin dark outlines on most strand edges, darker brown recesses between the clumps, several pale highlight streaks on the fringe.
clumps.ours: About a dozen big flat clumps, each fringe clump with a thin pointed strand lying over it, thin dark lines on many strand and clump edges, darker brown recesses at the top front and on the image-right temple, pale streaks across the top front only.

colour.reference: Warm light brown, dominant sRGB about (152,112,80), a clearly darker brown shadow side on the image left and under the fringe, pale highlight strokes about (208,172,120).
colour.ours: Warm light brown, lit areas about (160,122,84); a deep brown shadow (about (110,75,50)) on the image-right temple and side lock only in this front view - most of the front is flat lit colour; pale strokes across the top front.

sides.reference: Hair covers the temples down to about eye level with pointed tips, fuller on the image left; the top of the ear shows below.
sides.ours: Hair covers the temples down to about eye level with pointed tips; the image-right side is in shadow, the image-left side lit; the top of the ear shows below.
